blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and Canada have concluded negotiations for a free trade agreement (FTA) during President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney’s bilateral meeting on Saturday. The conclusion of negotiations was formalized through a joint statement signed by Trade Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque and Canada’s Minister of International Trade Maninder Sidhu.
